cards.title: Repeat with for
cards.body: A `for` loop runs its indented lines once for each value. The loop variable (here `i`) takes the next value each time round.
cards.code:
for i in range(3):
    print("hi", i)

hi.title: for se repeat karo
hi.body: `for` loop apni indented lines har value ke liye ek baar chalata hai. Loop variable (yahan `i`) har round mein agli value leta hai.

cards.title: range(start, stop)
cards.body: `range(3)` counts 0, 1, 2: it stops before the stop number. `range(2, 5)` counts 2, 3, 4.

hi.title: range(start, stop)
hi.body: `range(3)` 0, 1, 2 ginta hai: stop number se pehle ruk jaata hai. `range(2, 5)` 2, 3, 4 ginta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: Python stops with an `IndentationError`. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: The lines a loop repeats are indented. Line 2 needs 4 spaces in front so it belongs to the loop.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Python `IndentationError` dekar ruk jaata hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: Loop jo lines repeat karta hai woh indented hoti hain. Line 2 ke aage 4 spaces chahiye taaki woh loop ka hissa bane.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: range stops before its second number, so 3 is not included.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: range apne doosre number se pehle ruk jaata hai, isliye 3 shaamil nahi hai.

exercise.prompt: Read a number N and print the numbers from 1 to N, one per line. Use a `for` loop with `range`.
exercise.promptHi: Ek number N padho aur 1 se N tak ke numbers print karo, har line mein ek. `range` ke saath `for` loop use karo.

# print 1 to n, one per line
